structured.approach: Attempt 3 fixes the G2 and G3 refusals by changing only the citations. No test or code changed. The checker does not count file: citations for the test files or ci.py, but the tool view (tool:repo) holds tests/test_risk.py and tests/test_forecast.py in full. Every statement about the tests now cites tool:repo. The 90% gate cites record:brief, which says "at least 90 percent". The CI figures are not in any citable item, so the claims leave them out. They stay in the output file as the verbatim CI output from this attempt's run. I listed the step's context items with context_list to confirm no CI tool view exists, re-ran `/usr/bin/python3 ci.py` (it passed), and checked git status: only files under tests/ changed in this step. Then I rewrote task.unit_tests.md in full with the corrected sources.

claims.text: tests/test_risk.py defines VendorRiskTest with test_vendor_risk_levels, test_vendor_risk_boundaries, test_vendor_risk_empty_and_early, test_vendor_risk_accepts_any_iterable, test_vendor_risk_no_llm and test_vendor_risk_exported, covering AC-03.1 to AC-03.8 of STORY-03.
The boundary test checks the exact 30 and 10 boundaries: vendor_risk([30]) is 'medium' and vendor_risk([10]) is 'low', following the boundary-day lesson L-007.
The boundary test also checks the rounded prediction: predict_delay_days([30, 31]) is 30, which gives 'medium', and predict_delay_days([10, 11]) is 10, which gives 'low'.

tests/test_forecast.py adds test_request_with_risk and test_request_without_risk_unchanged for AC-04.1 to AC-04.5 of STORY-04; test_predict, test_request_uses_config and test_request_with_explicit_config are kept unchanged.
test_vendor_risk_no_llm patches explain.load_config and explain.build_explanation_request and asserts that vendor_risk calls neither (AC-03.7).
Before this step, CI failed only on coverage: 83.3, with risk.py lines 17-20 and explain.py line 21 not covered; the planned CMP-4 and CMP-5 tests were left for the unit-test work (CQ-C1).
The workbook action for this step requires at least 90 percent code coverage.
The tests need no secret, credential or network call in any environment; models.json holds only provider, model and max_tokens.
Per feat.stories SA-6, a lane may add new test files instead of using the existing one; task.code plans CMP-4 as a new tests/test_risk.py.

open_questions: CQ-DS-1: please confirm the test file split at review. The new tests/test_risk.py holds the STORY-03 tests; the STORY-04 tests are added to tests/test_forecast.py.
UT-1: AC-03.5 (PQ-1), AC-03.6 (TQ-5) and AC-04.5 (TQ-4) are tested against interim answers. If any answer changes, the matching assertion must change too.
Carried from task.code, unchanged: CQ-C2 (version 0.10.0), CQ-DS-3, RAQ-1, TQ-8, PQ-5.
